email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Funnel Strategist & Copywriter role. I'm a Belgium-based digital marketer who writes content that has to perform — landing pages, SEO blog content and website copy for client sites in consultancy, e-commerce and non-profit — and then tracks what happens once it's live in Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs.

baverok.com is mine end to end: I designed the site, hand-coded a landing page with a free site-check enquiry flow, and wrote every word of it. For mirook.com I ran iterative audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score. At Episto and KXP I handle keyword research, on-page SEO and content for multiple client websites.

I want to work where copy is judged by revenue rather than traffic, and where I can own the funnel behind the words. I'd welcome the chance to share samples or take a test brief.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Funnel Strategist & Copywriter position. I write copy that has to convert, and I measure it afterwards — which is the combination this role is built around.

Most of my work sits where messaging, page structure and performance data meet. I designed, wrote and built baverok.com myself in WordPress and Elementor, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero and a free site-check enquiry flow: one page, one clear next step, written to move a visitor from curiosity to action. For mirook.com, a site for a Belgian youth chess champion, I wrote and optimised the content, implemented structured data and ran iterative technical SEO and GEO audits that measurably raised the site's search-health score.

At Episto I handle on-page SEO, keyword research and SEO content for client websites in consultancy, e-commerce, a pharmacists' association and two Shopify stores, tracking results in Semrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics and Google Search Console. At KXP I ran SEO analyses, reported on performance and built WordPress sites for clients. Before that I worked as a front-end developer on a healthcare application, so I can ship a copy change to a live page myself instead of waiting in a queue.

I start from the audience — reviews, competitor messaging, keyword data — before writing a word, and I read and study copywriting continuously. I use LLMs daily for research, competitor analysis and drafting. What attracts me here is the short feedback loop: real traffic, real funnel data, and copy I can defend, test and revise. I'm comfortable being told I'm wrong when the data disagrees; I'd rather find the better argument than win the first one.

Based in Belgium, fluent in English, and happy to share samples or work through a test brief.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok
